handoffs.message: Helper-claimed by Codex2 while Codex completes higher-priority work.
promotion-svc is ready for review: added POST/GET approvals and deployments, /__health__, Dockerfile/requirements, compose wiring, python smoke validation, and docker compose config validation.

Review requested changes: POST /api/v1/deployments currently returns 201 for a nonexistent approval_decision_id and never loads/stores the referenced ApprovalDecision for contract validation. Reproduced with FastAPI TestClient using approval_decision_id=missing -> 201. docker compose config passes; docker compose build promotion succeeds; docker compose up promotion reached healthy, so the remaining issue is the deployment/approval linkage contract.
Helper-claimed by Gemini while Claude completes higher-priority work.
Helper-claimed by Claude while Codex completes higher-priority work.

All artifacts verified complete: services/promotion/main.py implements POST/GET /api/v1/approvals (ApprovalDecision), POST/GET /api/v1/deployments (DeploymentPlan), and GET /__health__. Dockerfile matches project pattern (python:3.11-slim, port 8089 hardcoded consistent with other services). requirements.txt has fastapi/uvicorn/pydantic — governance modules use stdlib only. docker-compose.yml already has the promotion service with correct port/volume/healthcheck. Ready for review.

Review failed: POST /api/v1/deployments does not satisfy acceptance on a fresh service. POST /api/v1/approvals only creates a proposed ApprovalDecision, but deployment creation requires a decided+approved approval; planning-session acceptance explicitly requires both POST routes to succeed.

Review failure fixed: added POST /api/v1/approvals/{decision_id}/decide that transitions proposed→decided with any outcome. Full fresh-service flow now works: POST /approvals → POST /approvals/{id}/decide → POST /deployments all return success. GET endpoints and /__health__ unchanged. Smoke verified.

Review request changes: POST /api/v1/approvals/{decision_id}/decide mutates proposed -> under_review before full validation. Repro on fresh app: create approval, call decide with outcome=approved_with_conditions and conditions=[], API returns 422, but subsequent GET /api/v1/approvals shows decision_state=under_review instead of remaining proposed. Make the transition atomic or roll back on ValueError, then re-handoff to review.

Atomic fix applied: decide_approval now works on a deepcopy of the ApprovalDecision before any mutation. If decide() raises ValueError, the original in-memory object is untouched and put() is never called, so GET /api/v1/approvals always returns the pre-mutation state. Ready for re-review.
Review approved: atomic decide fix is correct and verified; owner can finalize to done.
